item.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
item.description: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces dept（Apple Machine Learning Research）

item.title: Kling AI 发布 Kling Image 4.0：原生 8K 图像生成与高级文字渲染 / Native 8K. Stunning realism. Consistent image sets. Advanced text rendering.

item.description: Google 宣布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 正式上线，主打速度和日常任务，现已可在 Gemini 应用和 Search 中使用。该模型面向多样化的智能体工作流设计，强调快速高效执行；官方称其能更紧密地遵循指令、更准确地调用工具，用更少的来回沟通产出可靠结果。（X：Google (@Google)）

item.title: 腾讯混元开放 Hy4 权重 / Today, we’re releasing the open weights for Hy4.
